title: check_typed_item_calls: Move main logic under if __name__ == '__main__'
description:
Python 3.14 changed the default start method from fork to forkserver
on POSIX systems. With forkserver (or spawn, the default on Windows
or macOS), the main logic must be under `if __name__ == '__main__'`

See https://docs.python.org/3/library/multiprocessing.html
https://docs.python.org/3/library/multiprocessing.html#multiprocessing-programming

notes.body: enabled automatic add to merge train when checks pass
I'll fix up the other scripts that also use the ProcessPoolExecutor..
